{{Top|leg}}
A '''pneumatic door''' was just one of any number of portals that would open automatically when a [[Sentience/Legends|life form]] or [[Droid/Legends|droid]] neared its aperture. It would then close behind the individual. These automatic doors could be found in a variety of commercial and domestic structures as well as a range of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and other [[Realspace/Legends|space]]-going vehicles.
